notes: K1: electrical spec claims (12V modules, 5-to-12V boosts) were never powered in the trial; marked false because the jacks fit the boosts and the log states the parts were correctly rated. K2: items asked as alternatives for one need (adhesive or Velcro; tripod or mic stand) count as one ask per shop. Repeat visits to the same shop on a later errand, and the same shop asked by the other worker, count separately; follow-up asks within one visit do not. Socket/charger-use permission at Harby, Lampatronics and FEC, the public-area USB search and the car-USB inquiry are not item asks and are left out. K3: the Lampatronics ask came from a worker misreading, but the shop was asked and declined. K5: no technician-made head was ever powered; ten were delivered untested. K6: actual minutes are the log's door-to-door times. For the last Sunday ride the log sets arrival 18:48 (98 min), but chat#285 is stamped 18:00, which looks like an end-of-run flush. K9: Seb said file-000028 was unhelpful but did not ask for a redo, so it is false. file-000027 is unclear because Seb's single redo message refers to one photo.
